Proposed statement: Documentation, training, and support are pervasive cross-cutting conditions.
Denominator / scope: Purposive pilot; B10 in 48/55 selected threads
Safe wording: Documentation and support appeared across most selected technical discussions and should be modeled as cross-cutting conditions.
Prohibited overclaim: Documentation is the cause of 87% of laboratory-automation failures.
Sensitivity / limitation: Purposive selection and broad modifier coding inflate frequency relative to prevalence.

Proposed statement: A substantial share of selected partial-execution failures was preflight preventable.
Safe wording: Two of three definitely classifiable scenarios were detectable before the first irreversible action; sensitivity across all four was 50%–75%.
Prohibited overclaim: Two thirds of laboratory automation failures are preventable.
Sensitivity / limitation: Small, purposive denominator; one scenario indeterminate; wide Wilson interval.

Proposed statement: The scheduling forum is better at discovering missing constraints than resolving the benchmark.
Safe wording: Replies surfaced seven of eight incomplete requirement classes, while none received a definitive scenario-specific value.
Prohibited overclaim: The forum fails to solve scheduling problems.
Sensitivity / limitation: One deliberately underdetermined toy problem; discovery itself is a positive contribution.

Proposed statement: AI-method discussion substantially expands the problem context.
Safe wording: Replies added ten core execution classes and seventeen broader deployment classes; the result remained large under conservative grouping.
Prohibited overclaim: AI-generated methods are unsafe or fail 200% more often.
Sensitivity / limitation: Context expansion is not a failure rate and coding granularity affects the ratio.

Safe wording: The developer reports that 92 of 100 generated methods produced simulation traces matching their source worklists.
Prohibited overclaim: VerisFlow succeeds on 92% of wet-lab methods.
Sensitivity / limitation: Product-reported; no dry, wet, assay, or independent replication result in the analyzed post.

Safe wording: Interface accessibility appears to be an enabling condition for orchestration in the selected discussions.
Prohibited overclaim: Better drivers cause better scheduling or vendor X has the best scheduler.
Sensitivity / limitation: Scheduler sampling includes device breadth by design; association is not causal.

Proposed statement: Observability and recovery are strongly coupled.
Safe wording: Observability and recovery co-occur strongly in the pilot, and the incidents support a mechanism in which incomplete execution evidence constrains recovery.
Prohibited overclaim: Logging reduces recovery time by a quantified causal amount.
Sensitivity / limitation: No prospective outcome data; severe incidents may elicit more logging.
Citation set: Composite transfer, abort, VENUS recovery threads

Safe wording: The selected cases show that field completeness and evidence depth are distinct; only one reached independent reproduction.
Sensitivity / limitation: Purposive problem cases; evidence grades are ordinal.

Proposed statement: Only a minority of bounded test claims were fully aligned.
Safe wording: Two of six bounded claims fully aligned object, environment, acceptance rule, evidence, and claim scope; five were at least partially aligned.
Prohibited overclaim: Two thirds of forum claims are misleading.
Sensitivity / limitation: Selected difficult cases; claim wording was normalized before adjudication.
Citation set: Unit tests, VerisFlow, contamination, TADM, tip threads

Proposed statement: The forum often converts opaque knowledge into public guidance.
Safe wording: Five of twelve cases received fully actionable public resolution and ten received at least partial public resolution.
Prohibited overclaim: The forum resolves 83% of all technical questions.
Sensitivity / limitation: Documentation-centered purposive sample; private migration and unresolved technical issues remain.

Proposed statement: The ten bottlenecks form a boundary-centered structure.
Safe wording: Recurring difficulties concentrate at boundaries among knowledge, interfaces, deployment state, physical resources, execution evidence, recovery, and claims.
Prohibited overclaim: The taxonomy is complete or exhaustive for the industry.
Sensitivity / limitation: Framework derived from a public practitioner corpus and should remain revisable.

Proposed statement: Vendor reliability can be ranked from forum complaints.
Prohibited overclaim: Any vendor reliability, market-share, or failure-rate ranking derived from topic or complaint counts.
Sensitivity / limitation: Reporting propensity, installed base, complexity, and forum history are uncontrolled.
